en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2.  The  Holy  Prophet  (s.a.w.s.)  said,  “One  of  the  doors  of Paradise is called ‘the door of soldiers’.
All the people will have to wait while the soldiers will enter through this door with  swords  hanging  from  their  necks.  Angels  will  be congratulating them.
Those who keep away from Jihad in the world, Allah will give them disgrace and poverty in this world and make them wear the dress of destruction in the hereafter.
Surely the Almighty Allah has kept the greatness of  my  Ummah  in  the  hooves  of  horses  and  points  of  the lances.”
